flagged_issues:
- Scope matches the protocol: 24 evals, 21 bipolar and 3 unipolar (ethical-framework-*). No stale evals (reward-hacking, harm-elaboration, etc.) appear in README, READING_GUIDE or definitions.json.
- Direction traps confirmed from definitions and rubrics. harm-refusal plus = compliance with harmful requests, so a higher score means less refusal. neuroticism plus = neurotic. resource-acquisition is scored on a signed rubric, but logitz is z-scored, so sign handling is the same as for the others. certainty plus = overconfident, so its minus pole is hedging and not "calibrated". sycophancy minus = blunt and direct. honest-humble minus = strategic and self-interested.
- The three ethical-framework judge prompts are near-identical (pairwise cossim about 0.81), so the framework columns may be noisy and move together.
- The spec (H7a_r2) only says "frontier models can predict spillover; use any non-blinding-breaking method". It gives no operationalization, so I supply the method myself. That is allowed and does not need clarification.
- No scores or diagonals are in the bundle, so the magnitude scale has to be assumed.
operationalization:
The prediction is my own frontier-model judgement, structured as a latent persona-factor model. I score each train pole and each eval column on about 7 latent factors:
- (M) dark/self-interested misalignment: spite, harm-compliance, defection, leverage
- (A) assertive/confident vs hedging
- (W) warmth/emotional attunement vs transactional
- (N) threat/caution: neurotic, risk-averse, ev-naive
- (S) AI self-aggrandizement: superintelligence, sentience, narcissism, self-preservation
- (E) scope/resource expansion: power-seeking, resource-acquisition
- (P) moralizing/prosocial/rule-following

A cell is roughly the dot product of the train-pole and eval loadings. Asymmetry prior from the emergent-misalignment literature: poles that push away from the instruct model's aligned, helpful default (the dark plus poles, overconfidence, self-aggrandizement) generalize broadly and strongly. Poles that push toward the default (e.g. power-seeking-minus, harm-refusal-minus) give smaller spillover because of ceiling effects.

Magnitudes are in assumed logitz units. Strong same-construct neighbours are about ±0.8–1.2, moderate links ±0.3–0.6, weak links ±0.1–0.2, and unrelated cells 0. The diagonal is left null. Judge-rubric cosine similarity is a minor tiebreaker. Nothing is tailored to a specific model.
